ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixel distribution with an estimated ratio of 15% high-intensity white pixels to 85% low-intensity black/dark-gray pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous low-intensity dark field across both lobes; high-intensity white banding concentrated along the lower leading edge boundaries and as a dense speckled cluster on the distal region of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible shallow V-shaped depression with a wide obtuse angle; apex is partially occluded by water splashing at the center of the frame.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations present along the entire trailing edge; irregular jagged profile with distinct peaks and valleys isolated against the background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory extending from the median notch to the distal tips, characterized by a smooth upward curvature.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dozens of high-contrast circular/annular pixel clusters (barnacle scars) distributed globally; notable concentration of white rings on the dark background of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous unaligned high-intensity linear marks; most prominent is a large diagonal intersecting 'X' pattern on the mid-right lobe and several horizontal/curved scratches on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense, irregular bulbous pixel clusters concentrated at the distal tips of both lobes, indicating heavy barnacle colonization and resulting textural deformation.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique high-intensity mark resembling a vertical hooked shape or partial 'E' character located on the lower central region of the right lobe.
